name: Reallusion Hub · content-sync
note: Sync content between Reallusion Hub and local iClone/CC5 libraries. Lists available content, downloads selected packs, and verifies installation. Uses the Reallusion Hub CLI or REST API when available.

rows.label: content_id
rows.note: Reallusion marketplace content ID or pack name

rows.label: target_app
rows.note: which app library to sync into

rows.label: 1 list
rows.value: Query Reallusion Hub for installed/available content

rows.label: 2 download
rows.value: Download selected content pack via Hub API

rows.label: 3 install
rows.value: Install/verify content in target app library
